lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1}
  {S : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  [ProperSpace E] (β : NNReal) (u : E) {R ε : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hε : 0 < ε),
  ε ≤ ↑β * R ^ 2 →
    ∀ (φ : ℝ → ℕ) (next : S → E ⊕ E) (update : S → E → ℝ × E → S) (s₀ : S),
      have δ := NNReal.mk (ε / R ^ 2) ⋯;
      have N := ⌈↑(φ (2 * ↑β / ↑δ)) * Real.log (↑δ * R ^ 2 / (ε / 2))⌉₊;
      (∀ (g : E → ℝ),
          Differentiable ℝ g →
            StrongConvexOn Set.univ (↑δ) g →
              LipschitzWith (2 * β) (gradient g) →
                ∀ (w : E),
                  IsMinOn g Set.univ w →
                    ‖w - u‖ ≤ R →
                      ∃ t x c,
                        execute next update (fun y => (g y, gradient g y)) N s₀ = ((t, some x), c) ∧
                          g x - g w ≤ ε / 2) →
        have corrected := fun s y a => update s y (a.1 + ↑δ / 2 * ‖y - u‖ ^ 2, a.2 + ↑δ • (y - u));
        ∀ (f : E → ℝ),
          Differentiable ℝ f →
            ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f →
              LipschitzWith β (gradient f) →
                ∀ (z : E),
                  IsMinOn f Set.univ z →
                    ‖z - u‖ ≤ R →
                      ∃ t x c,
                        execute next corrected (fun y => (f y, gradient f y)) N s₀ = ((t, some x), c) ∧
                          f x - f z ≤ ε ∧ c ≤ ⌈↑(φ (2 * ↑β * R ^ 2 / ε)) * Real.log 2⌉₊ ∧ c ≤ φ (2 * ↑β * R ^ 2 / ε)
approved_definition_context: The operator execute takes pure deterministic next:S→X⊕Q, update:S→Q→A→S, oracle:Q→A, query fuel n and initial state s. It inspects next(s) first. At inl x return ((s,some x),0), including zero fuel. At inr q and zero fuel return ((s,none),0). At inr q and fuel k+1, obtain a=oracle(q), let tail=execute next update oracle k (update s q a), and return (tail.1,tail.2+1). Only the explicit oracle branch increments this counter. Some x is success; none is exhaustion. Arbitrary computation inside supplied functions is uncharged.

E is a complete real inner-product space, with its induced norm. ProperSpace means every closed bounded ball is compact. Differentiable R f means everywhere Frechet differentiable, gradient is the actual Riesz gradient of that derivative. ConvexOn R Set.univ is global convexity; StrongConvexOn Set.univ m g uses the additional subtraction (m/2)t(1-t)||x-y||² in the convex chord inequality. LipschitzWith K h means dist(hx,hy)<=K dist(x,y) for all x,y.

NNReal means nonnegative reals; NNReal.mk a proof packages a real a with its nonnegativity proof and coerces back to a. Natural ceiling is max(0, integer ceiling); it is the least nonnegative integer at least the real argument. IsMinOn f Set.univ z means f(z)<=f(x) for every x. Have-bindings are local expression definitions.
